Also replace every existing remove postcondition resource DLL::store_dll(storeA, linklist_node, nil) * storeA(linklist_node, DLL::getData(removed)) with xizi_dll_detached(linklist_node) * storeA(linklist_node, DLL::getData(removed)). It replaces empty store_dll as the public returned detached structural resource in remove_member_spec, remove_front_spec, remove_tail_spec, and strong_spec; storeA payload remains separate.
spec_hint: Use exact predicate name xizi_dll_detached and exact standalone Require/Ensure syntax requested. Prefer a transparent alias over existing DLL structural self-link assertion if semantically exact. Do not retain store_dll(storeA, linklist_node, nil) in any remove postcondition.
preferred_hidden_properties: A detached DLL node owns node_next and node_prev and both point to itself.
